:::{#exm-marginal-pmf}
#### Summing a row of the joint PMF

In @exm-joint-pmf, summing the $X_1 = 1$ row:

$$
\ba
\P(X_1 = 1)
&= \P(X_1 = 1, X = 0) + \P(X_1 = 1, X = 1) + \P(X_1 = 1, X = 2)
&& \text{(marginal PMF from the joint PMF)} \\
&= 0 + \tfrac{1}{4} + \tfrac{1}{4}
&& \text{(read the table)} \\
&= \tfrac{1}{2}
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

which matches $X_1 \sim \Ber(1/2)$ from @exm-bernoulli-pmf.

:::
